description: Add an XML comment or processing instruction to an element (Structure pane menu > New Comment, New Processing Instruction), or edit an existing one by id (Edit)

id.description: Edit the comment or instruction with this id (from list_xml_structure)

kind.description: An XML comment or a processing instruction

parent.description: Or: add it to this element (default: the root). An XML element: its id (from list_xml_structure), its path of child indexes from the root element ([] is the root), the first element an XPath expression matches, or selection: true for the element selected in the Structure pane (or the selected tagged item). Give exactly one

path.description: Child indexes from the root, e.g. [0, 2] is the third child of the root's first child

selection.description: Use the element selected in the Structure pane

xpath.description: XPath expression evaluated from the root element, e.g. //article[@id="a1"]

name: set_xml_comment_or_instruction
title: Set XML Comment Or Instruction
